result.title: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
result.comment: 28 pages, 12 figures, 25 tables. Accepted at the World Models in Physical AI Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Prediction errors from video world models are often treated as physical surprise, but they can also reflect appearance, static content, motion, or ordinary prediction difficulty. We present an evaluation framework that separates what frozen representations contain, how they organize appearance and physical differences, and what changes a model's own prediction error. On IntPhys2, a benchmark of physically possible and impossible events, we compare representations from latent prediction, masked pixel reconstruction, and simple visual statistics. Appearance remains easy to decode, while V-JEPA2 exposes modest information about whether events are possible or impossible. Looking at the latent geometry, appearance changes become smaller compared with differences between videos, their directions line up more consistently across scenes, and their overlap with physical changes decreases in deeper layers. Across action-conditioned models, incorrect actions raise prediction error, while appearance changes also produce substantial responses. In Physion++ video clips, repeating a single frame can produce higher error than the original clip, while changing color throughout the clip can lower it. Using Kubric, a simulation and rendering framework, we find that impossible events can produce lower error than possible events. A fixed error threshold also incorrectly flags many possible events as impossible. A model can therefore represent physical information and respond to incorrect actions without its native prediction error reliably measuring physical surprise.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出评估框架，区分冻结视频世界模型表示中包含什么、外观与物理差异在潜空间几何中如何组织，以及模型预测误差如何响应动作错误、外观变化与物理不可能事件，并在 IntPhys2、Physion++ 和 Kubric 上检验「预测误差即物理惊讶」这一假设。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于潜表示内容、外观与物理因素解耦及误差信号有效性的诊断，直接关联 LVR 中「latent 是否保留任务必要视觉信息」与「误差或证据信号能否支撑停止与计算分配」的评价问题，可供核查。
